name: speedboat course furniture contract
about: ONE contract read by the Blender course build (scripts/blender/course/*.py), the checker (scripts/blender/course/checkCourseGlb.mjs), the runtime (src/circuit/courseFurniture.ts) and tests/circuitAssets.test.ts. docs/speedboat/circuit.md explains each rule. Boats have their own contract (src/speedboat/assets/assetContract.json); the course reuses the pipeline, not the slots.

frame.forward: +Z = the face toward the boats that approach it (daymark, lamp board, street front)
frame.origin: still water (y = 0) at the spar / buoy / stake / pylon axis; the old GROUND FLOOR for roofs; still water at the mast axis for the tower
frame.blender: Blender (x, y, z) = three (x, -z, y), as the boat pipeline (sb_conventions.three_to_blender)
frame.instancing: every node has an identity transform; the runtime draws each variant node as one InstancedMesh per primitive per LOD

slotTextureScaleNote: fraction of the asset's textureSize per slot; an asset's own slotTextureScale overrides this one slot by slot

C_Steel.surface: galvanised and painted structural steel: lattice, spars, cages, rails, tin roofs

C_Paint.surface: painted panels: daymarks, buoy bodies, hazard and chequer bands, reflective tape, stencils

C_Build.surface: shingles, brick, clapboard, timber, concrete, ceramic

C_Lamp.surface: lamp lenses and strobes; the runtime drives emissive per node from extras.lamps

roofs.about: per variant, metres above the old ground floor (the placement's `floor`). ridge = highest roof line, eave = lowest roof edge, top = highest point (chimney, parapet, spire, tank).

budgetNote: triBudget / drawBudget are per PLACED INSTANCE: the heaviest of `instances` (each a list of variant nodes one placement draws; 'Name*' = the heaviest variant matching the prefix; a variant may repeat). Draws count primitives before instancing merges them across placements.
